# Metric definitions

## Definitions

### Paying broker

Counts: a broker on a paid plan on the last day of the month, and never a broker on a free trial.
Where the number lives: the billing system

### Payback period

Counts: the months it takes a paying broker to pay back what it cost to win them.
Where the number lives: [your call: where is this counted?]

## Counts that are different numbers

The ad platform's own count of sign ups resembles a paying broker and is a different number, never to be mixed with it.

## What is not decided yet

Nobody has decided which price the payback period divides by.
